text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Realizing the path to victory too late, 
Ikuno Dictus let the win slip away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though defeated, she realized once again 
that experience would become her greatest 
weapon. And so, she resolved to grow even 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after the Yasuda Kinen. Ikuno 
Dictus's fatigue was lower than 
anticipated. The Trainer feels her 
undeniable growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And next up is finally the Takarazuka 
Kinen. The grand finale of the Senior Year 
spring goals.
